content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Advanced Annotation Targets and Backing Fields** as part of **Advanced Kotlin Language Features**. Annotations and code-generation tools add metadata or generated code; reflection has runtime/tooling costs and Kotlin reflection/JVM APIs have their own maturity considerations. Use the subtopics—Use-Site Annotation Targets, Explicit Backing Fields, Interactions with Property Accessors—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Professional applications need repeatable tests, clear APIs, dependable dependencies, security checks, and observable failures. Apply this concept in small steps before integrating it into a larger project.
